samples.question: Start on the first of the 12 colored badges after the green START ring and follow the single purple track toward the red END ring. At a round badge, jump forward one badge. At a diamond badge, jump forward two badges, skipping the badge between. Read and obey only badges you land on. If a jump would go beyond the final badge, stop on your current badge. What color is that badge: cyan, amber, or rose?
